title: Return Noble USDC escrow to the migration multisig and freeze the Haqq USDC voucher
summary: Circle ends USDC support on Noble; the full pause is on 2027-01-12. This proposal returns Noble's full USDC escrow for Haqq (68,769.508250 USDC, Noble channel-32) to the multisig noble1REPLACE_WITH_MULTISIG over channel-4 (MsgReturnToNoble with that explicit amount), covering all Noble USDC vouchers (ibc/BFF0D3805B50D93E2FA5C0B2DDF7E0B30A631076CD80BC12A48C0E95404B4A41) still in circulation on Haqq. In the same execution it disables bank sends of the voucher, so the holder snapshot is the height emitted by the usdcmigration_return_to_noble event. Holders are repaid off-chain from that snapshot: REPLACE_WITH_REPAYMENT_PLAN_URL.
